morphology.pattern_note: -nya 在此通常是表示第三人称领属的附着代词，并非派生后缀；依本结构归入 suffix。词根不变，ny 表示 /ɲ/。headword.jawi 按输入保留，但 ڤروت 仅为词根拼写；完整 perutnya 写作 ڤروتڽ。

senses.zh_definition: 他或她的肚子、腹部，即胸部以下的身体前部。
senses.en_definition: His or her belly or abdomen.
senses.ms_definition: Bahagian hadapan tubuh seseorang di bawah dada.
senses.nuances: -nya 的具体所指须由上下文确定，本身不区分男女。词根各义参见[PRPM：perut](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=169476&keyword=perut)；附着代词书写参见[DBP 说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kamu+nya)。

collocations.en: to stroke his or her belly

senses.zh_definition: 他或她的胃；日常语言中也可笼统指消化器官所在的腹内区域。
senses.en_definition: His or her stomach, or digestive region in everyday usage.
senses.ms_definition: Perut seseorang sebagai organ atau kawasan pencernaan.
senses.nuances: 日常所说的腹痛不能据此定位为胃部疾病。

collocations.en: his or her stomach is empty

senses.zh_definition: 她孕育胎儿的腹中；借指子宫或孕腹。
senses.en_definition: Her womb or pregnant belly, in nontechnical usage.
senses.ms_definition: Rahim atau kandungan seseorang wanita, secara kiasan.
senses.nuances: 医学语境应按实际部位使用 rahim 等准确术语。

senses.zh_definition: 他或她赖以维生的食物、生计；粗俗或贬义的借代用法。
senses.en_definition: His or her food or livelihood, in coarse figurative usage.
senses.ms_definition: Makanan atau rezeki seseorang, dalam penggunaan kasar.
senses.nuances: 多见于批评只顾口腹或个人利益的表达。

collocations.en: to fill his or her belly
to care only about feeding oneself

senses.zh_definition: 某物的内部、下部或鼓起的中部。
senses.en_definition: Its interior, underside, or bulging middle.
senses.ms_definition: Bahagian dalam, bawah atau tengah sesuatu yang menyerupai perut.
senses.nuances: 比喻用法；具体部位取决于所指物体。

senses.zh_definition: 其所属的母系亲族支系；见于米南加保习俗语境。
senses.en_definition: His or her matrilineal kin group in Minangkabau customary usage.
senses.ms_definition: Kelompok keturunan sebelah perempuan dalam adat Minangkabau.
senses.nuances: 专门文化义，非日常“肚子”义；以下为语境搭配。

collocations.en: members of his or her matrilineal group
the head of his or her matrilineal group

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Pekerja itu memaklumkan kepada penyelia bahawa perutnya sakit dan memohon kebenaran untuk ke klinik.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该员工向主管说明自己腹痛，并申请获准前往诊所。
dual_scenarios.en: The employee informed the supervisor that his stomach hurt and requested permission to visit a clinic.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Amir tak jadi ikut makan; perutnya sakit sejak tadi.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Amir tidak jadi makan bersama kita kerana perutnya sakit sejak tadi.
dual_scenarios.zh: 阿米尔不跟我们去吃饭了，他从刚才就肚子疼。
dual_scenarios.en: Amir isn't joining us for the meal; his stomach's been hurting for a while.
spoken_features: 省略已知的 kita，符合熟人聊天习惯。
日常口语也常说 perut dia；此处保留目标形式 perutnya。

messages.zh: 阿米尔不跟我们去吃饭了，他从刚才就肚子疼。
messages.en: Amir isn't joining us for the meal; his stomach's been hurting for a while.

messages.speaker: Mei Ling (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Oh, dia dah balik rumah ke? Aku nak telefon dia jap.
messages.ms_standard: Adakah dia sudah pulang ke rumah? Saya mahu menelefonnya sebentar.
messages.zh: 哦，他已经回家了吗？我想打个电话给他。
messages.en: Oh, has he gone home already? I'll give him a quick call.

etymology.historical_story: Perutnya has a transparent modern structure: perut followed by the attached pronoun -nya. Historical comparative work reconstructs an older Malayic form *pərut and discusses possible Austroasiatic connections, although that deeper proposal should not be treated as settled. For learners, the dependable connection is the unchanged body-part word plus a context-dependent possessor. See [comparative linguistic research](https://bahasawan.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/Lexical-evidence-in-Austronesian-for-an-Austrasiatic-presence-in-Borneo-corrected.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: perut＝肚子，-nya＝他或她的：perut + nya，就是“他或她的肚子”。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 描述自身不适很自然；未经邀请评论别人的肚子大小可能失礼，对长辈或不熟悉的人尤其如此。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 不凭腹部外观猜测怀孕，也不以 perut buncit 嘲笑身材；涉及健康或孕情时尊重当事人隐私。
